Hyper Wave Festival.

An original live property connecting Japanese and Indonesian music audiences.

At a glance

Japanese Station / Hyper Wave Festival

Member

Year

Capabilities
IP & Creative / Live & Activation
5,000+festival attendees

Project scope

A two-day cross-cultural music festival with three Japanese artists and five Indonesian bands.

The challenge

Build an original festival with a credible audience proposition, sponsor story and international artist program.

Member contribution

Rinintha created the festival concept and led creative direction, sponsorship narrative, artist liaison, venue coordination, executive production and show delivery.

Outcome

The festival brought 5,000+ attendees together across two days, with a line-up including VAMPS and NIDJI.

This work predates dot.wave. Project outcomes belong to the wider project and its collaborators; the contribution above identifies the member’s role.
